policy: The APK build exports and bundles one pinned upstream YOLOv8 detector and verifies its ONNX CPU smoke test. This is perception only, not an autonomous gameplay policy.

models.purpose: Detect Player, Bush, Enemy, and Cubebox objects in captured game frames
models.license: AGPL-3.0 as declared in upstream OpenVINO metadata; the APK includes the source checkpoint and license text
models.runtime: ONNX Runtime Android, bundled in the APK
models.smoke_test: Build workflow exports the model, checks ONNX graph, and runs CPU zero-input inference before packaging

models.purpose: Choose movement and attack actions from validated game state
models.notes: No trained action policy is integrated. Automated gestures remain disabled.

models.purpose: Read health, timer, match phase, and other HUD values

limitations: Model accuracy on current game versions, skins, phone resolutions, and portrait/landscape captures has not been validated.
A successful zero-input smoke test proves runtime compatibility, not detection quality.
The bot does not yet automatically choose and execute gameplay actions.
